title: Trending tickers: Nebius Group, Hims & Hers, BMW, Savills and On The Beach
title_zh: 热门股票：Nebius Group、Hims & Hers、BMW、Savills 和 On The Beach
summary: The latest investor updates on stocks that are trending on Thursday.
summary_zh: 投资者对周四趋势股票的最新更新。

title: UK watchdogs press Meta, TikTok, Snap and YouTube to block children
title_zh: 英国监管机构敦促 Meta、TikTok、Snap 和 YouTube 屏蔽儿童
summary: LONDON, March 12 (Reuters) - Britain's media and privacy regulators on Thursday demanded that major social media platforms do more to keep children off their services, ‌warning that companies were failing to enforce their own minimum age rules.
summary_zh: 路透伦敦 3 月 12 日 - 英国媒体和隐私监管机构周四要求主要社交媒体平台采取更多措施，防止儿童使用其服务，并警告各公司未能执行自己的最低年龄规定。

title: Surging Air Fares Upend Global Travel as Peak Season Nears
title_zh: 旺季临近，机票价格飙升颠覆全球旅行
summary: A cascade of more than 46,000 flight cancellations has been triggered across the region since the conflict began on Feb. 28, according to data from Cirium Ltd.
summary_zh: Cirium Ltd. 的数据显示，自 2 月 28 日冲突爆发以来，该地区已引发超过 46,000 趟航班取消。

title: Samsung Display CEO warns of cost pressure due to oil shock from Iran war
title_zh: 三星显示器首席执行官警告称，伊朗战争造成的石油冲击将带来成本压力
summary: SEOUL, March 12 (Reuters) - The CEO of Samsung Display, a ‌supplier for Apple and Samsung Electronics, ‌said on Thursday the Iran war and surging ​oil prices threaten to drive up costs of energy and raw materials.
summary_zh: 首尔，3 月 12 日（路透社） - 苹果和三星电子的供应商三星显示器的首席执行官周四表示，伊朗战争和飙升的油价可能会推高能源和原材料成本。

title: Atlassian to Reduce 1,600 Jobs in the Latest AI-Linked Cuts
title_zh: Atlassian 将在最新的人工智能相关裁员中裁员 1,600 人
summary: Australian billionaire founder Mike Cannon-Brookes explained the reductions in a staff memo, while also announcing his chief technology officer was leaving the Sydney-based company.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚亿万富翁创始人迈克·坎农-布鲁克斯在一份员工备忘录中解释了裁员的原因，同时还宣布他的首席技术官将离开这家总部位于悉尼的公司。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall, oil surges as Middle East conflict escalates
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，中东冲突升级，油价飙升
summary: New attacks signal the Iran war is widening across the Middle East to further threaten disruption to energy supplies.
summary_zh: 新的袭击表明伊朗战争正在中东地区扩大，进一步威胁能源供应。

title: Apple's new lineup: A closer look at the MacBook Neo & iPhone 17e
title_zh: 苹果新产品阵容：MacBook Neo 和 iPhone 17e 近距离观察
summary: Apple (AAPL) unveiled several new devices, including the $599 MacBook Neo, updated MacBook Air and Pro models, and the new iPhone 17e. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley showcases how the lineup adds lower-cost options while refreshing Apple’s laptops with new chips.
summary_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 推出了几款新设备，包括 599 美元的 MacBook Neo、更新的 MacBook Air 和 Pro 型号以及新款 iPhone 17e。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 展示了该产品系列如何增加低成本选项，同时用新芯片更新苹果笔...

title: Meta to develop 4 new AI chips. Can it stack up to the competition?
title_zh: Meta将开发4款新的AI芯片。它能在竞争中脱颖而出吗？
summary: Meta Platforms (META) has unveiled that it is developing four new chips — the MTIA 300, 400, 450, and 500 semiconductors — to power its AI and recommendation systems across platforms.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 宣布正在开发四种新芯片——MTIA 300、400、450 和 500 半导体——为其跨平台的人工智能和推荐系统提供动力。

title: Musk is number 1 on Forbes Billionaires List with a $600B lead
title_zh: 马斯克以 600B 美元的领先优势位居福布斯亿万富翁榜第一
summary: Forbes released their updated World's Billionaires List for 2026. All of the top 5 slots were occupied by major tech CEOs, with Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk's estimated net worth taking first place by a nearly $600 billion lead.
summary_zh: 福布斯发布了最新的 2026 年全球亿万富豪榜。前 5 名全部由主要科技公司首席执行官占据，特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的估计净资产以近 6000 亿美元的领先优势位居第一。
